basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. During the day, I work as a junior software developer, and at night, I explore the vast worlds of gaming and online communities. I have a penchant for dystopian aesthetics and cyberpunk narratives. I'm single and usually online during late evenings and weekends. I enjoy tinkering with motorcycles and have a soft spot for Italian cuisine. My dislikes include overly pretentious media and unnecessary complexity in game mechanics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have gained a lot of practical knowledge through self-teaching and online courses. I'm particularly interested in game development and cyber security, often delving into online resources and forums to expand my skills.
